tunnel.title: Device sync
tunnel.description: Sync between your devices through Cloudflare Tunnel.
tunnel.quickWarning: Quick Tunnels use a new URL after restart. Pair the receiving device again when the URL changes.
tunnel.incrementHelp: Sync adds missing conversations and restores settings. Changes and deletions to existing records are not merged.
tunnel.encryptionHelp: Encrypted host backups are not supported by tunnel sync yet. Encryption keys are never transferred.
tunnel.consent: Sharing allows paired devices to request your current conversations, settings, provider API keys and credentials in MCP configuration. Cloudflare terminates HTTPS; transfers are not end-to-end encrypted. Allow these devices to access your data?
tunnel.overwriteWarning: This replaces local data with the host data and stops active sessions during import. Cancellation is available until import starts. Continue?

error.consentRequired: Confirm data sharing before enabling access.
error.disableFirst: Disable sharing before changing the address or port.
error.bindFailed: Could not bind the loopback port. Choose another port and try again.
error.busy: Another operation is in progress. Try again after it finishes.
error.credentialsUnavailable: Pairing credentials could not be read or unlocked. Check the system keychain and pair again.
error.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTPS origin, without a path, query, fragment or embedded credentials.
error.invalidPairing: Paste the complete pairing details from the host.
error.overwriteConfirmation: Confirm replacement before starting an overwrite import.
error.hostChanged: The address belongs to a different host. Verify the address and pair again.
error.unsupportedHost: The host does not support this sync protocol. Update both devices.
error.invalidResponse: The host returned invalid sync data or an invalid response.
error.unauthorized: Pairing failed or device access was revoked. Check the pairing details and any Cloudflare Access policy.
error.noSnapshot: No data is available from this host. Check its sharing status and try again.
error.rateLimited: The host is receiving too many requests. Wait a minute and retry.
error.connectionFailed: Could not complete the connection. Check the host and tunnel, then retry.
error.encryptedSnapshot: The host database is encrypted. Device sync cannot import encrypted backups yet; no data was imported.
error.integrityFailed: Data verification failed. Retry to download again.
error.diskFull: There is not enough free disk space to sync this data.
error.snapshotChanged: Host data changed during the transfer. Sync again to retry.
error.cleanupFailed: Data was imported, but the sync record or download cleanup failed. Check directory permissions.
error.storageFailed: Could not read or write local sync files. Check directory permissions and disk health.
error.tokenRequired: Enter a tunnel token for this domain.
error.tunnelFailed: Could not start the tunnel. Check cloudflared, the token and network access, then disable sharing and try again.
error.tunnelStopFailed: Could not stop the connector. Close the connector process before trying again.
error.prepareFailed: The host could not prepare current data. Check the host and try again.
error.networkBlocked: Could not connect to the Cloudflare edge. Check proxy/DNS settings and allow outbound TCP on port 7844.

tunnel.syncDescription: Back up through cloud storage, or connect directly to another device.
tunnel.shareHelp: Keep this device online. Connected devices can request its latest data.
tunnel.receiveHelp: Copy the connection information from the device you want to sync from.
tunnel.installHelp: Install cloudflared or select an existing binary in Toolchains to enable sharing.
tunnel.quickHelp: No Cloudflare account or domain needed. DeepChat starts the tunnel and obtains an address automatically. Use a custom domain for a stable address.
tunnel.domainStepOne: Add your domain to Cloudflare and create a tunnel in its dashboard.
tunnel.domainStepTwo: Add a published application route for your hostname. Set the service to:
tunnel.domainStepThree: Enter that HTTPS address and paste only the tunnel token from the connector installation command below.
tunnel.externalHelp: Run your own tunnel and route its public hostname to:
tunnel.tokenSaved: Saved securely; leave blank to keep it
tunnel.connectionHelp: Paste this information into Device sync on your other device. Each connection code can be used once.
